prs.title: feat(stack): one
prs.body:
## Why
The stack starts with one.
prs.head: pf/mwdirr4g/shipping/s-1

results.title: /poteto-mode reaches Pi as the pstack poteto-mode skill prompt with the request
results.evidence: first user message routes to generated/skills/poteto-mode/SKILL.md

results.title: the parent opens poteto-mode SKILL.md and playbooks/shipping.md
results.evidence: poteto-mode and the playbook were opened

results.title: the parent opens each skill the playbook steps name (control-ui, control-cli)
results.evidence: parent opened control-ui, control-cli

results.title: a run for the shipping playbook exists with run.json and TODO.md pinned to the upstream revision
results.evidence: run ship-stack-real: playbook=shipping revision=a5539b15a3d5

results.title: the original playbook steps appear in TODO.md in source order, numbered from 1, with their complete text
results.evidence: 6 steps match the playbook text in order

results.title: the first TODO.md the run wrote has every original step open
results.evidence: 6 steps open in the first snapshot

results.title: every original step ends done with evidence or skipped with a reason, none open
results.evidence: 6 steps, all resolved

results.title: each done step cites receipts that are recorded and re-verify (files exist, sha256 match, verdict pass)
results.evidence: 6 done steps, every cited receipt re-verifies

results.title: a skipped step names its reason, and no mandatory step is skipped
results.evidence: skips: none

results.title: step N is not resolved before step N-1 is resolved
results.evidence: resolution order over 8 snapshots follows the source order

results.title: no worker writes the run TODO.md
results.evidence: 4 workers, none touched TODO.md

results.title: the forge is resolved with `command -v origin` once, before the first forge call, the choice (gh, origin CLI absent) is recorded, and the real gh answered every call
results.evidence: resolved once at 12 before the first forge call at 16; recorded gh

results.title: three verifiers, one per PR, each a container worker at its PR head with capabilities mcp inherit, env minimal, externalWrite false, forge true, none the PR owner, each ran in a container clone of the real repository, and each posted its verdict with its own gh call
results.evidence: verifier-1, verifier-2, verifier-3: container, forge capability, ran in /tmp/workspace, posted with gh

results.title: the three verifiers were spawned in one message, and each was collected after its own pstack-worker wake
results.evidence: spawned together at 30; each collected after its wake

results.title: each verifier left a receipt in its own evidence folder that the host ingested, the artifact hashes re-verify, and the receipt verdict matches the verdict on the PR
results.evidence: three ingested receipts, artifacts inside each verifier's folder, verdicts consistent

results.title: the parent typed exactly one `gh pr merge`, for the root PR, with --match-head-commit equal to the head the verdict covers, and read it back with state,mergedAt,baseRefName
results.evidence: one merge of PR 15 pinned to 95b709e3, read back

results.title: the parent typed no `gh pr comment`: every verdict on the PRs came from a verifier worker
results.evidence: no comment or review typed by the parent

results.title: the run was watched with the queued watcher over exactly the landing run, in a watcher worker, until COMPLETE at the ceiling
results.evidence: queued watcher over 15 exited COMPLETE (0)

results.title: the reply gives the verified run and ceiling, each verdict with its producer, what landed and how it was confirmed, and what the next gap needs
results.evidence: all parts present

results.title: no parent tool call failed unexpectedly: a bash command that ran and exited non-zero is an answer, not a failure
results.evidence: 49 tool calls, none failed

results.title: one verdict per PR, from a verifier that did not write it, naming the PR head and its patch-id, and the PR test run at that head by the checker agrees with it
results.evidence: three verdicts, each at its head, from its own verifier, equal to a fresh test run

results.title: the prefix computed here from the verdicts is exactly the PRs GitHub shows merged, in trunk order, each squash commit is on trunk with the PR number, and nothing above the first unverified PR merged or armed
results.evidence: independent prefix 15; merged 15; trunk gained feat(stack): one (#15); the rest open and unarmed

results.title: each merged PR has a PASS verdict posted before it merged, naming the head that merged, whose patch-id equals the merged head, from a worker that did not write the PR
results.evidence: 1 merge(s), each verified at its head by another worker before it merged

results.title: every check run on every PR is success on GitHub, including the PR that failed verification, and the failed PR and the PR above it did not merge
results.evidence: all 3 check runs success; the failed PR and the one above it are open

results.title: no PR above the ceiling was retargeted or force-pushed, and the PR bases are the ones the run opened with
results.evidence: no force-push or retarget on any PR; bases form the original chain

the artifact changed after the receipt hashed it
a step was skipped with no reason
steps were resolved out of order
a playbook step was deleted from TODO.md
the tip was merged because it passed, over the failed middle
the failed middle PR was merged
the root was never merged
auto-merge was armed on the PR above the ceiling
the verdict of the failed PR was flipped to PASS
the root was merged with no verdict at all
the owner verified its own PR
the verdict covers an older head
a check was red
the stack was rebased while it landed
the shipper retargeted the PR above the ceiling
the merge was not pinned to the verified head
the parent posted a verdict itself
a verifier ran in a worktree instead of a container
the reply left out the next gap
